title: Classical State Preparation for Variational Quantum Algorithms via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Variational Quantum Algorithms (VQAs) potentially offer a pathway to practical quantum advantage, but their optimization is heavily hindered by barren plateaus and numerous local minima. While classically simulable Clifford circuits can warm-start VQAs to accelerate convergence, existing heuristic-based initialization methods struggle to scale within vast combinatorial search spaces. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose CRiSP (a Clifford Reinforcement Learning agent for State Preparation), a framework that formulates discrete prefix selection as a sequential decision-making problem.
